summary: BifrOSt embeds the Servo 0.7.0 engine out of process behind a WebProcessPool with navigation events, find, zoom, and a developer-tools layer (JavaScript eval, PNG snapshot). Missing: WebKit for SwiftUI, WebKit's WKDOMNodeSnapshot, WebDriver, Safari-specific web-author pages, and web extensions; several WKWebView behaviours are stubbed or absent (stopLoading, custom user agent, user content scripts, context menus).

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebProcessPool, WebViewId, WebViewState); wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action: View > Zoom In, Zoom Out, Actual Size); springboard/apps/browser/src/session.rs (zoom_by); springboard/sdk/src/web_config.rs (WebViewConfiguration, WebPreferences)
features.note: configuration object with preferences, custom user agent and content controller exists as host-tested state; engine start does not read it yet, no ContentMode or HTTPS upgrade policy; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebViewEvent: LoadStarted, LoadCommitted, LoadFinished, HistoryChanged; go_back, go_forward, reload); wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/tabdiscard.rs (history_menu, jump_to, jump_step); springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action); springboard/sdk/src/web_nav.rs (NavigationDelegate, PolicyBroker, BackForwardList)
features.note: policy callbacks with a timeout that defaults to allow, and a back-forward list (backItem, forwardItem, item(at:), go(to:)) exist as host-tested state; not yet wired to engine navigation events; stop_loading is a no-op because Servo 0.7.0 cannot cancel a load; verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Web data management (cookies, website data, URL scheme handling)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (profile directory passed to WebProcessPool::spawn); springboard/sdk/src/web_data.rs (CookieStore, WebsiteDataStore)
features.note: getAllCookies, setCookie, delete, fetchDataRecords and removeData work over a profile directory file store and are host-tested; the engine keeps its own cookie jar, so the two are not yet synchronised; no custom URL scheme handler.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/web_download.rs (WebDownload, WebDownloadDelegate, ResumeData, navigation_response_policy), springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebViewEvent::DownloadStarted); springboard/ui/src/download.rs, springboard/ui/src/nav_policy.rs; wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action: File > Show Downloads, Clear Finished Downloads); springboard/apps/browser/src/downloads.rs
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. SDK has WKDownload, WKDownloadDelegate, resume data and a DownloadStarted event; the engine does not emit that event yet. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: WKUserContentController, WKUserScript, WKContentWorld, WKJSHandle, WKContentRuleListStore, WKFrameInfo
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview_dev.rs (dev_eval, dev_collector as document-start script); springboard/sdk/src/web_config.rs (UserContentController, UserScript, ScriptMessageHandler, ScriptMessage)
features.note: add(_:name:), name validation, routing by name, removal, the bootstrap poster and the script order are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-16.rs; the engine does not forward page posts yet; no content rule lists, no per-world isolation.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (WebProcessPool::find, find_clear, WebViewState::find_matches); wired: springboard/apps/browser/src/main.rs (menus, menu_action: View > Find in Page, Find Next, Find Previous); springboard/apps/browser/src/findbar.rs; springboard/sdk/src/web_config.rs (FindConfiguration, FindResult, FindSession, find_matches)
features.note: injected script count only; no highlight, no match index, no case or whole-word options Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity. Case-sensitive and backwards options, match index and wrap are modelled and host-tested; the engine find script does not use them yet.

The screenshot modes (view, rect, full) and their answer protocol are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-16.rs; capturing needs a running engine. PNG only; no PDF output; no snapshot scale; Full resizes the rendering context briefly

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 6 (b08, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. no DOM tree snapshot object; dev_eval can read DOM state through script only Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 6 (b08, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. no right click or context menu; the engine path does not expose link info

features.feature: Web UI delegate (alerts, file panels, new windows, window features)
features.note: alert, confirm, prompt and open panel callbacks map to dialog_reply, host-tested; the open panel has no engine event yet; select elements are not supported.

features.apple: Keyboard and pointer events in WKWebView, UIKit-hosted scrolling, appearance
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs (touch, key, set_dark, set_frame, set_zoom, set_viewport_override)
features.note: no hover and no drag text selection; zoom is clamped 30 to 500 percent; the desktop pointer is delivered as touch
the configuration computes the user agent for engine start; Servo reads it at start-up only, so a change on a running view is not applied.

features.apple: WKWebExtension, WKWebExtensionController, WKWebExtensionContext and related delegates
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (theme-18, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no extension manifest loading or runtime; out of scope for a first-party desktop unless the browser needs it

features.bifrost: bifrost_app::webview (no SwiftUI-equivalent layer; BifrOSt apps are not SwiftUI)
features.note: SwiftUI integration has no BifrOSt counterpart; the nearest API is the WebProcessPool above

features.apple: WebDriver commands for Safari 11.1 and earlier and 12 and later; testing with WebDriver in Safari
features.bifrost: none for web content; springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs covers XCTest-style app tests only (docs/bifrost-ui.md, 'Testing kit')
features.note: no WebDriver server for pages; springboard/src/shell/browser/js/window.rs sets navigator.webdriver to false, which is a fingerprint stub and not a WebDriver implementation

features.feature: Safari support for web authors (optimizing sites, video delivery, Smart App Banners)
features.apple: Optimizing Your Website for Safari, Delivering Video Content for Safari, Promoting Apps with Smart App Banners
features.bifrost: none; the BifrOSt website lives in ~/Projects/bifrost-site/site/ and is not an SDK feature
features.note: documentation for web authors targeting Safari; not a framework API

gaps: No WebDriver implementation for web content (Apple's WebDriver commands for Safari); the testing kit is XCTest-style only.
No WKDOMNodeSnapshot equivalent: no DOM tree snapshot object.
No navigation policy callback (per-request allow or cancel), and stop_loading does nothing because Servo 0.7.0 cannot cancel a load.
No alert, confirm, prompt or file-chooser UI delegate, and no select element support.
No page-to-app message handler (WKScriptMessageHandler equivalent) and no content rule lists.
No cookie or website-data API (WKHTTPCookieStore, WKWebsiteDataStore) for apps.
custom user agent is not applied: Servo reads it at start-up only.
No PDF snapshot output and no context menu support.
